summary: Fortress Credit Realty Income Trust, a Maryland non-traded REIT, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting net asset value per share for each outstanding class of common shares as of August 31, 2026, disclosed September 16, 2026, with no transaction, offer, strategic action, or security-holder solicitation announced. NAV per share ranged from approximately $19.8207 (Class J-2) to $20.0594 (Class J-4), with total NAV of $1.458 billion across 73,087 thousand shares, versus $1.403 billion and 70,294 thousand shares at July 31. Assets comprised $3.267 billion of commercial real estate loan investments and $386.5 million of real estate-related investments, offset by $2.249 billion of secured debt. This is a routine monthly valuation disclosure with no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock; watch only for valuation drift in the loan book given the sequential NAV expansion.
